translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Matyiw
book.title: MATYIW Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Matyiw Tikak

content: Jon Binuk Gunap Aŋgyokek Jiysis Nup Niŋniŋg Wiyak
Jiysis binuk onep wimiŋgan ak kuyip, kun kun giy ginimimb aŋgiy aŋgñirep giy, miñmon kun ak kirgiy, dawin yep maŋ kun okok amiy, biynimb gok kuyip minim aŋgñak.
Pen Jon bi ñiŋg pikñemb ak kalambis mindiy, Krays yerer gak minim ak niŋiy, binuk gunap aŋgyokek Jiysis mindek ak amiy,
nup aŋgniŋiy aŋgyak, “Nand mey bi kiyŋ yomb key yimb aŋgiy per kond mindpun ak nep opan akaŋ, bi kisenimb kun ak key kond mindonjun?”
Aŋgeyak Jiysis kuyip aŋgak, “Nimb Jon mindip amiy aŋgnimimb, ‘Chin amiy niŋbun:

bi kun ak biynimb windin koy gip gok gamb windin niŋbay. Biynimb timund miŋgan pil gip gok gamb gos niŋbay. Biynimb tomb timey gip gok gamb kinjeŋ taŋgrep gipay. Biynimb soy ayndik ayip gok gamb milip gip. Biynimb kumbay gok gamb tip tikjakpay. Biynimb simbgeprek gok kunep Gor minim tep ak aŋgek niŋbay aŋgnimimb.’
Pen minim bap aŋgnimimb, ‘Biynimb yip gosimb niŋiy, gosow gosow ma niŋbay gok, miñmiñ yimb giniŋgiy aŋgnimimb aŋgak.’”

Kun aŋgek, Jon binuk gok amniyakniŋ, Jiysis biynimb ap mindeyak gok kuyip, Jon minim ar ak aŋgiy aŋgak, “Nimb nind miñmon nep namb okok amnimbik ñin ak, yerip giniŋg ambik? Sund par nokom bap yiŋgen diy, dand amiy apiy gek niŋniŋg ambik?
Akaŋ yenen ambik? Bi chech teprep nep aypay gok niŋniŋg ambik? Bi chech teprep dun aŋgiy niŋbay gok, biyomb korip kilrimey okok kinbay.
Pen tap yerip ak niŋniŋg ambik? Yikop ma ambik. Jon bi Gor minim aŋgep ak niŋniŋg ambik. Bi Gor minim aŋgep winiŋgamb aŋgiy kond mindyiŋgipim mey, bi kun ak.
Nup aŋgiy Baybol buk ak tikiy aŋgyak:

content.text: ‘Bi minim aŋgep yand ak aŋgen nind amiy, biynimb gok aŋgrep gek, kisen Ñiyand ak aŋgen niniŋgamb aŋgiy tikyak.’

content: Nimbip aspiyn: Jon biynimb man ar biy, maŋgiysek wiyniym gip ak pen; Gor biynimb yikop yimb diy kond mindeniŋgamb gok, Jon rek ma mindeniŋgambay; Gor biynimb tep nuk yimb gok mindeniŋgambay.
Jon bi ñiŋg pikñemb ap minim tep aŋgñak ñin ak tikiy, biynimb gok Gor chinup diy kond mindonimuŋ aŋgiy, kilis gi dand apiy, miñiy kunep kilisrimey yimb gipay.

“Mosis low minim tikak ak sek, bi Gor minim aŋgep gunap minim tikyak ak sek kiñiŋ ak mey, Gor Kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak nup yokek, nuk biynimb gok kuyip diy kond mindeniŋgamb. Minim kun ak aŋg dand apey apey mey, Jon owak.
Pen minim aŋgniŋg gispiyn ak diniŋgambim akaŋ ma niŋbiyn. Gor Jon nup aŋgek ap biynimb gok kuyip minim aŋgñak ak; Baybol buk ak tikiy giniŋgamb aŋgyak rek nep gak. Tikiy aŋgyak,

content.text: ‘Bi Gor minim aŋgep Yilayja rek bap nind apek; bi kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak kisen winiŋgamb aŋgyak.’

content: Nimb biynimb gos timund sek gok, minim kun ak niŋnimimb.
“Biynimb miñiy ñin biy mindpay gok yand niŋbiyn: kiyk ñapan ŋaŋ gunap, ñapan ŋaŋ gunap kuyip apay rek ak mindpay.
Ñapan ŋaŋ gunap meŋg miŋgan dand araniy apay, ‘Chin akil puŋgon, nimb yenen kamep ma apim? Kamep siy aŋgep rek ak aŋgon, nimb yenen siy ma apim apay?’
Kun ak rek Gor Jon nup yokek apiy, ñin gunap tap ma ñimbiy, ñiŋg wayn ak ma yimb ñimbiy gek aŋgyak, ‘Bi kun biy nup tap yerip ak ambaŋ ayek kun gip aŋgyak.’

Bi bap Ñinuk pen apek apay, ‘Bi tap yomb ñimbiy, ñiŋg wayn kuŋay ñimbiy, bi takes dipay gok yip, bi tap siy tap timey gipay gok yip taŋgip apay.’ Apay kun ak, biynimb gosimb ma mindip gok rek apay aŋgak.”
Minim Yomb Diniŋgambay

Jiysis miñmon yomb gunap nind giraŋgiy, tap mageprek gek niŋyak ak pen; yenen tap siy tap timey gipun aŋgiy, nup chiŋgiy mindrep ma giyak. Kun gey, Jiysis kuyip kuŋay yimb aŋgiy aŋgak, “Korasin biynimb gok diy, Betsayda biynimb gok diy tap mageprek gok gen niŋiy kirpay rek, minim yomb yimb diniŋgambay. Taya biynimb gok sek, Saydon biynimb gok sek kuyip tap mageprek kun gok nind rek gembinip niŋiy, chech bek band rek gunap yimiy, tun maŋgiysek giy mindembiyap.
Kun ak kor yomb ñin ak, Taya biynimb sek, Saydon biynimb sek minim sikoy rek diniŋgambay; Korasin biynimb gok sek, Betsayda biynimb gok sek minim yomb yimb ak diniŋgambay.

“Pen ñin kun ak Kapaniyam biynimb gok, semb biyoŋ ma amniŋgambay; pisnep mon key yinjap kaw miŋgan ak amniŋgambay. Sodom biynimb, nimb timey yimb gipim rek ma giyak ak pen, kuyip mon yinak. Nimbik tap mageprek gok gen niŋbik ak pen, Gor nup gosimb ak ma niŋbim.
Ar kun ak yand nimbip niŋind yimb aspiyn: kor yomb ñin ak apek, Sodom biynimb gok minim sikoy rek diniŋgambay; nimb Kapaniyam biynimb gok, minim yomb yimb ak diniŋgambim aŋgak.”
Yand Bapiy Nup Niŋbiyn, Nuk Yip Niŋimb

Ñin kun ak Jiysis Nop nup aŋgak, “Bapiy nand Biyomb. Semb biyoŋ sek, man biy sek kond mindpan ak, gos nand key niŋey tep gip rek, biynimb gos tipaŋgiy niŋbun apay gok kuyip kirgiy, biynimb ñapan ŋaŋ rek mindpay gok kuyip gos tep ñimban ak, nip tep aspiyn aŋgak.”

Kun aŋgiy aŋgak, “Bapiy kilis nuk mindip rek, yip ñimb. Biynimb gunap yip ma niŋrep gipay; Bapiy nep yip niŋimb. Yand nep Bapiy nup niŋrep gipiyn. Pen biynimb gos tep ñiyn aŋgiy niŋbiyn gok, gos tep ñen, nup niŋbay aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgiy aŋgak, “Nimb biynimb mindrep ma giy kosyam mindpim gok maŋgiysek, yip ker apem, gen kapkap mindrep giniŋgambim.
Yand bi sayn tep kapkap mindpiyn rek, yand yip nep taŋgiy miñ yand ak niŋrep giy mey, mind tep giniŋgambim.
Minim yip niŋiy yand yip taŋgem mey, nimbip miker per gip rek ma giniŋgamb aŋgak.”
